title: Glaceon (Pokémon)
text:
Glaceon (Japanese: グレイシア Glacia) is an Ice-type Pokémon introduced in Generation IV.
It evolves from Eevee when leveled up near an Ice Rock or when exposed to an Ice Stone.
(Specifics may differ in past games. Refer to Game data→Evolution data for these details.)
It is one of Eevee's final forms, the others being Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, and Sylveon.


== Biology ==

Glaceon is a quadrupedal, mammalian Pokémon covered in light-blue fur. It has long, pointed ears, dark eyes, and a small nose. A teal crest with two dangling flaps adorns its head, resembling hair or headgear. Glaceon has two dark blue, rhombus-shaped markings on its back; the tip of its tail, feet, and flaps are the same shade of blue.
By quickly lowering its body temperature to −75 °F (−60 °C), Glaceon can freeze its fur into needle-sharp icicles that it can fire. This is used for a number of purposes, such as self-defense, tackling prey, or staying safe while it sleeps. Doing so also lets it instantly freeze the moisture in the atmosphere with just a single cry to create small ice crystals and a flurry of diamond dust or ice pellets at its food. The diamond dust is noted to be gem-like in nature and glitters as it flutters around. Those captivated by Glaceon's beautiful snowfall will be frozen without realizing it. It is popular in ski resorts for its ability to create powdery snow from the coldness it generates.


=== Evolution ===
Glaceon evolves from Eevee.
(For specifics on this Pokémon's Evolution in the games, refer to Game data→Evolution data.)
